## Required GitHub Secrets

| Secret | Description | How to Get |
|--------|-------------|------------|
| `KEYSTORE_BASE64` | Base64-encoded keystore | `base64 -i release.keystore` |
| `KEYSTORE_PASSWORD` | Keystore password | From `keytool` creation |
| `KEY_ALIAS` | Key alias | From `keytool` creation |
| `KEY_PASSWORD` | Key password | From `keytool` creation |
